title: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Pakistan (Protection of Evacuee Property) Ordinance, 1948.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force in such areas and on such dates as
may be notified in the Official Gazette.
[Note.-This Ordinance was published in the Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, dated the 18th October 1948. Vide Notification No. 2(18) 48-P. R.,
dated 20th October 1948, this Ordinance has been made applicable to the
Provinces of North-Western Frontier, West Punjab and Sind and Capital of
Federation with effect from 20th October 1948. The West Punjab Act No. VII of
1948 exists and has not been repealed. It is, however, necessary to note here,
that in case of any conflict between the provincial act and this Ordinance, the
provisions of the Ordinance will prevail.]

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
2. Definitions.-In this Ordinance, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context :-
(a) "Custodian" means a Custodian of Evacuee property
and except where the context otherwise requires includes an Additional, Deputy
or Assistant Custodian ;
(b) "Evacuee" means any person who by reason of the
disturbances arising out of the setting up of the Dominions of Pakistan and
India, has been or is absenting himself from Pakistan and whose property in
Pakistan is for the aforesaid reason not personally occupied, supervised or
kept by him or whose business or undertaking in Pakistan has for the aforesaid
reason ceased whether wholly or partially to be carried on or is being carried
on by an unauthorised person ;
(c) "Evacuee property" means the property in Pakistan
owned by an evacuee or vesting in him under any trust or instrument and
includes property in Pakistan obtained from an evacuee by lease, sale or
exchange on or after the 1st August, 1947.
[Note.-It has been held by the Lahore High Court in Civil Revision
No. 97 of 1948, reported as P L D 1949 Lah. 50 that a claim .based on a
mortgage of immovable property for a sups constitutes a claim to immovable
property.]
(d) "Prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under
this Ordinance.
(e) "Property" means property of every description,
movable or immovable, and all rights in or to such property, but does not
include ;-
(i) cash deposits in -bank.
(ii) any actionable claims other than claims in respect of any
undertaking or business of which the Custodian assumes possession or control.
(iii) debts other than those towards which payment is tendered
voluntarily by debtors ;
(f) "Refugee" means a person who being previously
domiciled in India has taken refuge in Pakistan from any part of India by
reason of the disturbances arising out of the setting up of the Dominions of
Pakistan and of India ;
(g) "Rehabilitation Authority" means any Rehabilitation
Officer or Deputy or Assistant Rehabilitation Officer appointed under the
provisions of the Pakistan (Economic Rehabilitation) Ordinance, 1948, or under
any law relating to the social and economic rehabilitation of refugees in
Pakistan for the time being in force ;
(h) "unauthorized person" includes an agent, manager or
partner of an evacuee appointed or admitted as such after the 14th August 1947,
and whose appointment or admission has not been approved by the Custodian.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Appointment of custodian additional deputy and assistant custodians

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
3. Appointment of Custodian, Additional, Deputy and Assistant
Custodians.-(1) For the purpose of carrying into effect the provisions of this
Ordinance, the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette,
appoint one or more Custodians for such area as may specified in the
notification.
(2) No person shall be appointed Custodian, unless he is, or has
been a judge of a High Court within the meaning of subsection (1) of section
219 of the Government of India Act, 1935, and the term "Custodian" in
this subsection shall not be deemed to include an Additional, Deputy or
Assistant Custodian.
(3) An Additional, Deputy or Assistant Custodian shall perform the
duties imposed on him by this Ordinance under the such general superintendence
and control of the Custodian and shall obey the general or special orders not
inconsistent with the provisions of this Ordinance as may be issued by the
Custodian from time to time.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Operation of other laws

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
4. Operation of other laws.-(I) The provisions of this Ordinance
and rules made thereunder shall have effect notwithstanding anything
inconsistent therewith in any other enactment or in any instrument having
effect by virtue of any such enactment.
(2) Every order purporting to be made or signed by a Custodian in
exercise of any of the powers conferred by or under this Ordinance shall be
presumed to have been made or signed, as the case may be by the Custodian, and
so such order shall be called in question in any Court.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Persons ceasing to be evacuee

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
5.Persons ceasing to be evacuee.-An evacuee who satisfies the
Custodian or Rehabilitation Authority or Commissioner that he has returned to
Pakistan with the bona fide intention of permanent residence or of personally
carrying on his business shall cease to be an evacuee upon the Custodian,
Authority or Commissioner certifying in writing the fact of such satisfaction.
[Note.-Under this section concurrent jurisdiction is given to the
Custodian, Rehabilitation Authority and Commissioner to declare that an evacuee
has ceased to be an evacuee. This provision is defective for three reasons.
Firstly that the word "Commissioner" has not been defined in the
Ordinance ; secondly no provision has been made to check conflicting decision
by the different authorities and thirdly in case of conflicting decisions by
more than one authorities, which decision will be preferred.]

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Power to custodian to assume possession of evacuee property and vesting of such property in the custodian

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
6. Power of Custodian to assume possession of evacuee property and
vesting of such property in the Custodian.-(1) Subject to the provisions of
this Ordinance, a Custodian may, by a general or special order published in the
Official Gazette and specifying by location or description any evacuee property
or class of such property, take over or assume control of the property so
specified.
(2) From the date of the order, any person in possession of such
property shall hold it on behalf of the Custodian and shall, on demand
surrender possession of it to the Custodian or a person duly authorized by him
in this behalf.
(3) The Custodian may take such measures as he considers necessary
for preserving or safeguarding such property.
(4) No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie
against any person complying with the order of the Custodian by reason only of
such compliance.
(5) The Central Government may by order vest or provide for and
regulate the vesting in the Custodian of such evacuee property as may be
prescribed.
(6) When, in pursuance of an order under subsection (1) or (5) any
evacuee property is vested in a Custodian, neither the vesting nor anything
done in consequence thereof shall be invalidated or affected by reason only
that at a material time ;
(i) some person who was or might have been interested in the
property and who was an evacuee had died or had ceased to be an evacuee, or
(ii) some person who was so interested and was believed by the
Custodian to be an evacuee was not an evacuee.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Notwithstanding

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
7. Notwithstanding anything in any other enactment for the time
being in force every lease granted after the 1st August 1947, in respect of
agricultural land which is evacuee property shall terminate at the end of the
Kharif Season, 1948, on a date which shall be determined in the prescribed
manner, and such land shall thereafter vest in the prescribed Custodian ;
Provided that ----
(i) If the Custodian is satisfied that any such lease was not a
bona fide lease or was not granted for adequate consideration he may terminate
it forthwith ; and
(ii) in the case of a bona fide lease extending beyond the date
determined as aforesaid and for which rent for a period extending beyond such
date has been paid in advance the lessee shall be awarded compensation, to be
determined and paid in the prescribed manner for any loss attributable in the
premature termination of the lease under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Evacuee property required or allotted by rehabilitation authority

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
8. Evacuee property required or allotted by Rehabilitation
Authority.(1) Whenever any Rehabilitation Authority requires any evacuee
property for the purposes of the Pakistan (Economic Rehabilitation) Ordinance,
1948, or of the social and economic rehabilitation of refugees under any law
for the time being in force, the Authority shall send a written intimation to
that .effect to the appropriate Custodian, containing as complete a description
of the property as possible, and the property shall then be taken over by the
Authority on such terms and conditions as may be agreed upon by the Custodian
and that Authority.
(2) A person to whom a lease of evacuee property is granted by any
Rehabilitation Authority without compliance with the procedure laid down in
subsection (1) shall be deemed to be a lessee holding on terms and conditions
agreed upon by the Custodian and the Rehabilitation Authority concerned, and
the said Authority shall be deemed to be a duly authorised agent of the
Custodian for the purpose.
(3) It shall be the duty of the Rehabilitation Authority granting
such a lease as is referred to in subsection (2) to furnish to the Custodian,
immediately or as soon as maybe after the lease is granted, as full a
description as possible of the leased property.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Person in unauthorised possession of evacuee property

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
9. Person in unauthorised possession of evacuee property.-(1) If
any unauthorised person is
in possession of any immovable evacuee property a Custodian or a person
authorised by him in this behalf may, in his discretion, either eject him
summarily therefrom as a trespasser and may use such terms and conditions as
may be agreed upon between such person and the Custodian.
(2) If such person, being so accepted as a lessee, fails to comply
with any term or condition agreed under the preceding subsection he may be
summarily ejected from the property as trespasser.
(3) The powers conferred on the Custodian by subsections (1) and
(2) may subject to such conditions as may be specified in the order be
delegated by him to any Rehabilitation Authority b9 general or special order
published in the Official Gazette.
[Note.-The Custodian, West Punjab has delegated its powers to the
Deputy Rehabilitation Commissioners and the Director of Industries, West Punjab
under section 6 of Act VII of 1948, which corresponds to section 9 of the
Ordinance.]

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Penalty for non compliance with custodians order

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
10. Penalty for non-compliance- with Custodian's order.-Failure to
comply with any lawful order of a Custodian or a person duly authorised by him
shall be a cognizable offence punishable with imprisonment of either
description which may extend to one-year or with fine or with both.
sections.punishment:
punishable with imprisonment of either
description which may extend to one-year or with fine or with both.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Claims by interested persons

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
11. Claims by interested persons.-(1) Subject to the other
provisions of this Ordinance, any person in possession of or claiming any
interest in evacuee property may, by petition to the prescribed Custodian, ask
for a declaration--
(a) that the property in question is not evacuee property, or
(b) that it is evacuee property within the limits stated in the
petition.
(2) On receipt of such a petition, the Custodian may, hold an
enquiry, recording such evidence as the petitioner produces in support of his
claim, and may hold such further enquiry into the matter as he may deem fit.
(3) If he holds an enquiry, or further enquiry, the Custodian
shall, at the conclusion thereof, pass an order allowing the petition wholly or
in part on such terms and conditions as he may deem just or rejecting it
wholly.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Transfer of evacuee property

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
12. Transfer of evacuee property.-(1) No transfer of any right in
or over or to any evacuee property made by an evacuee, his agent, assignee or
attorney, on or after the 1st August 1947, shall confer any right or remedy on
the parties to such transfer or any person claiming under any of them unless
such transfer is confirmed by the prescribed Custodian upon application made to
him in that behalf within the prescribed period.
(2) The Custodian shall not confirm a transfer unless---
(a) The consideration is paid in his presence or, in the case of
exchanges or past transfers, the transaction is proved to the satisfaction of
the prescribed Custodian to be a bona fide one for adequate consideration, and
(b) there is produced before him a certificate signed by the
prescribed income-tax authority certifying that no objection to such transfer
on the ground that it might cause loss to the revenues of Pakistan exists.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Appeals

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
13. Appeals.-(1) An appeal shall lie to the Custodian from an
order of ejectment under section 9 passed by .a Deputy or Assistant Custodian
or by a Rehabilitation Authority, and from a summary order of rejection under
subsection (2) of section 11 or from an order under subsection (3) of that
section or from an order under section 12 passed by a Deputy Custodian or
Assistant Custodian.
(2) The appeal shall be presented in such manner and within such
time as may be prescribed.
(3) The Custodian to whom the appeal is presented may dispose of
it himself, or may matte it over for disposal, in the case of an appeal from a
Deputy Custodian, to an Additional Custodian, in the case of an appeal from an
Assistant Custodian, to a Deputy Custodian.
(4) Subject to any order that may be passed under the succeeding
subsection, any. original or appellate order passed by the prescribed Custodian
or the Additional Custodian and any appellate order passed by a Deputy
Custodian and, subject to any order in appeal, any original order passed by a
Deputy or Assistant Custodian shall be final and conclusive and shall not be
called in question in any Court by way of further appeal or revision or in any
original suit, execution application or other petition.
(5) A Custodian may at any time call for the records of any case
pending before or decided by an Additional, Deputy or Assistant Custodian and
after giving notice to the parties or making such enquiry as he think fit, pass
such order as may be called for in the interests of justice.
(6) A Custodian, but not an Additional, Deputy or Assistant
Custodian, may, after giving notice to the parties concerned, review his own
order.
[Note.-A Deputy Custodian can hear only such appeals which are
from the orders of the Assistant Custodian, provided they are entrusted to him
by the Custodian. The Custodian has power under section 13 (6) to review his
own order.]

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Jurisdiction of civil Courts barred in certain matters

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
14. Jurisdiction of Civil
Courts barred in certain. matters.-(1) No Court shall entertain or adjudicate
on a claim in any suit, appeal, execution application or other proceeding that
any property is or is not evacuee property or that an evacuee has or has not an
interest in such property, except in the case of a person who has been referred
to the Civil Court under section 20 of this Ordinance to establish his title.
(2) No decision of any Court on any claim such as is referred to
in subsection (1) given between the date prescribed in respect of any area and
the coming into force of this Ordinance, shall be binding on the Custodian or
shall affect the rights or interests of any evacuee in the property in
question.
(3) All Pr-,pert.: of which the Custodian has assumed possession
or control under section 6 of this Ordinance shall be exempt from attachment or
sale in execution of a decree of a Civil Court or in pursuance of an order
issued by any Court.
(4) No Court shall be competent to grant an injunction or other
order in relation to any act done or intended to be done by or on behalf of a
Custodian or in relation to any proceedings pending before a Custodian.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Custodian to have powers of civil Courts for certain procedure

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
15. Custodian to have powers of Civil Court for certain
procedure.--In any enquiry under this Ordinance the Custodian shall have all
the powers of a Civil Court setting in exercise of its original civil
jurisdiction in respect of the summoning -and examination of parties, witnesses
or other persons who in his opinion possess any relevant information or
document, and of the discovery or production of documents and the use of such
documents or copies thereof as evidence.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Powers of custodian

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
16. Powers of Custodian.-A Custodian shall have all such powers
not inconsistent with the provisions of this Ordinance, as may be necessary to
enable him.
(a) to take all proper measures necessary for carrying out his
duties under this Ordinance, and to incur expenditure incidental thereto in
accordance with the rules made under this Ordinance ;
(b) subject to the requirements of any Rehabilitation Authority
under section 8 of this Ordinance, to grant a lease in the prescribed form for
any period of any immovable property or any undertaking or business which is
ordered to vest in him ;
(c) to grant receipts for lease money paid by lessees to whom
leases have been granted by him or who have attorned to him, and for payments
made on accounts of any debt due to an evacuee whose property, undertaking or
business is in his possession or control ;
(d) to pay, out of moneys in his possession belonging to an
evacuee, or out of the income of any evacuee property belonging to that
evacuee, or out of the proceeds of the sale of such property, the power to sell
such property in case of necessity being hereby conferred upon him :-
(i) any taxes, duties, cesses, rates, which may be leviable by the
Central or any Provincial Government or any local authority in respect of the
evacuee of that or any other property, or undertaking or business of such
evacuee in the possession or control of the Custodian ;
(ii) the cost of necessary repairs to such property ;
(iii) the cost of completing any uncompleted building which is
situated on or is part of such property ; and
(iv) any sums due to any person claiming against the person or
property of any evacuee, if the claim in the opinion of the Custodian does not
involve any complicated question of law or fact or if the claim is based on a
decree or order of a competent Court ;
(e) to make payments out of the money held by him on behalf of
evacuees to refugees from prescribed areas in accordance with rules made under
this Ordinance ;
(f) to sell or direct the sale of any property in his possession
which is livestock, or subject to speedy and natural decay, or the sale of
which is in his opinion expedient or necessary;
Provided that if any such property consists of foodgrains
exceeding one hundred rupees in value it shall be offered for sale in the first
instance to the Civil Supplies Department of the Province concerned.
(g) to demolish any evacuee immovable property which is so damaged
as, in the opinion of the Custodian, is beyond repair and to sell the site of
such property and the material or other property salvaged from the debris ;,
(h) to complete any building belonging to an evacuee and left by
the evacuee in an incomplete state :-
(i) on the application of an Improvement Trust or other local,
authority the Custodian may, on such terms as he considers equitable. permit
that Trust or authority to erect or cause to be erected buildings on any land
which is evacuee property in the neighbourhood of a city or town if such land
is required in connection with any housing scheme or any scheme for industrial
expansion or other similar purpose ;
(j) in so far as it may be necessary for carrying out any of the
duties or exercising any of the powers imposed -or conferred by or under this
Ordinance to institute or defend, in his capacity as Custodian, any suit or
legal proceedings in relation to any property, undertaking or business in his
possession or control or any property of which he has; the right, power or duty
under this Ordinance, to take possession ;
(k) to enter or to authorise any other person on his behalf to
enter on any land or premises to inspect any evacuee property or take it into
possession ;
(1) to require any person to furnish such returns, accounts or
other information in relation to evacuee property and to produce such documents
as the Custodian considers neces

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Provisions regarding charge

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
17. Provisions regarding charge.-If a Custodian exercises the
powers conferred by clause (g) or clause (h) of section 16 the expenditure
incurred by him in that behalf shall be a charge on the properties involved in
such proportions as may be prescribed and shall have priority over any other
charge on that property, and such expenditure .may be met or recouped by the
Custodian out of the income or proceeds accruing from the properties concerned.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Persons making payments to custodian to be discharged of liability

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
18. Persons making payments to Custodian to be discharged of
liability.-Persons making payment
to the Custodian towards any debt due to an evacuee or towards rent due in respect
of any evacuee property shall be discharged from liability in respect of such
debt or rent to the extent of the payment made.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Levy of fees

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
19. Levy of fees.-(1) The Central Government may levy fees in
respect of any proceeding or enquiry held or made by a Custodian or iii respect
of any evacuee property of which the Custodian assumes control or possession or
which may vest in him by order of the Central Government.
(2) Such fees shall be payable by the person at whose instance or
in whose interest the proceedings or enquiry is held, or, as the case may be,
by the person to whole a lease of such property is granted, or by the owner, if
his whereabouts are known, and shall be a first charge on such property and in
default of payment shall be recoverable as an arrear of land revenue.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Restoration of property

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
20. Restoration of property.-Unless in the opinion of the
Custodian the restoration of any evacuee property to any evacuee owner would be
prejudicial to the purposes of this Ordinance, the owner shall, on application.
' to the Custodian and on payment of such excess, if any, of expenditure over
receipts in respect of such property, undertaking or business as appears from
the Custodian's account books, and of the fees leviable under section 19, be
entitled to the restoration of such property on such terms and conditions as
the Custodian may deem fit if he ceases to be an evacuee;
Provided that the Custodian shall give not less than 15 days
public notice of every such application by proclamation in the town in which
the residence or the business or principal branch of the business is situated,
and by notice affixed to the residence or premises of the business or branch,
and any other method which he may consider suitable, and where the application
is opposed, if the Custodian is not satisfied after such enquiry as he may
consider necessary, of the title of the applicant, he shall refuse to deliver
possession and may refer the applicant to a Civil Court;
Provided further that where the person making the application
claims the property as an heir to an evacuee owner, the Custodian may refuse to
hand over possession unless such person produces a succession certificate or
letters of administration or probate of a will granted by a competent Court in
respect of that property;
Provided further that every lease lawfully granted by the
Custodian any Rehabilitation Authority shall have effect as against the owner
of the property or any person claiming the property until determined by lapse
of time or operation of law.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Recovery of rents

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
21. Recovery of rents.-Rent recoverable in respect of any evacuee
property and the proceeds of the sale of such property may be recovered as an
arrear of land revenue.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Accounts to be maintained

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
22. Accounts to be maintained.-The Custodian shall keep such
accounts and in such form as may be prescribed and the accounts shall be
audited in the manner prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Bar of suits

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
23. Bar of suits.-No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding
shall lie against the Central Government or any Custodian or Rehabilitation
Authority or any person acting under the direction of such Custodian or
Authority for anything which in good faith is done or purports or is intended
to be done in pursuance of this Ordinance or for any loss or damage caused to
or in respect of and property which may be ordered to vest in the Custodian or
of which he has assumed control of possession.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Appearance of counsel or agent

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
24. Appearance of counsel or agent.--Any petition, whether in
appeal or otherwise, and any
application under this Ordinance may be presented in person or by counsel or by
duly authorised agent, and nothing in this Ordinance shall be deemed to forbid
appearance by counsel or such agent..

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Protection of Evacuee Property Ordinance 1948
sections.description:
Power to make rules

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1948
PAKISTAN (PROTECTION OF EVACUEE PROPERTY) ORDINANCE, 1948
25. Power to make rules.-The Central Government may, by
notification in the Official Gazette, make such rules as appear to it to be necessary for
carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
